turns.content: I've been having flashbacks to something that happened to me a few years ago. I thought I'd processed it but it's coming back.
Trauma can resurface unexpectedly. Are you working with anyone — a therapist or counsellor — to process it?
I was, but I stopped going. The sessions were bringing up too much and I couldn't function after. I've been white-knuckling it.
White-knuckling trauma is exhausting. How is it affecting your day to day?
I can't sleep without nightmares. I've been drinking more to cope. I've started to feel like I deserved what happened, like I always will be damaged.
Feeling permanently damaged and deserving of harm — those are distorted beliefs that trauma creates. They feel real but they aren't true. Are you safe right now?
I've been hurting myself. Cutting. It's the only thing that makes the noise stop. I know it's not okay but I can't stop.
